negative_findings.description: No evidence was found of a standalone ČNB 'CERTIS ročenka' (CERTIS yearbook) as a separate publication. Annual CERTIS figures appear to be carried in the CERTIS statistical-data pages and in the ČNB Výroční zpráva rather than in a dedicated annual volume.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Czech for 'CERTIS ročenka' returned the CERTIS statistics page, the instant-payments pages and the ČNB annual report, but no separate yearbook publication.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not wait on a yearbook that may not exist; annual CERTIS aggregates must be sourced from the statistics page plus the annual report.

negative_findings.description: ČNB open data appears to cover registers (banks, bureaux de change, credit intermediaries) rather than the payment/card/ATM statistical series. No SDMX endpoint for ČNB was identified; ARAD exposes a proprietary REST API instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching for ČNB SDMX returned only ECB/UNICEF SDMX material plus the ARAD REST API PDF. The ČNB open-data page enumerates register-type datasets.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline assuming SDMX compatibility with ECB tooling will fail for CZ national series; the ARAD REST contract must be implemented separately.

negative_findings.description: Institution-level (bank-by-bank) payment, card and terminal data reported via SDAT under reports PSSIVYC22 / PSSIVYP22 is not publicly available; only ČNB aggregates are published.
negative_findings.result_summary: The reporting-methodology pages describe the granular fields, but the SDAT application requires registered reporting-entity credentials.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level card/ATM/POS shares cannot be obtained from ČNB and must be triangulated from other cells (acquirers, card schemes, bank annual reports).

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live by this agent; all URLs come from search-result metadata and snowballing. Several are deep PDF/gallery paths that change between publication cycles.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores only; liveness is deferred to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Deep .galleries/download/*.pdf paths on cnb.cz are the most likely to 404 after a site reorganisation; the verifier should re-resolve them from their index pages rather than marking them dead.

negative_findings.description: The ECB SPACE study (payment attitudes / cash usage at POS) covers euro area member states only — 20 countries in the 2024 wave. No Czech sample.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched for CZ inclusion in SPACE; all results confirm euro-area-only scope, with DE and NL running comparable national surveys. Czechia absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single best European demand-side cash-usage instrument does not cover CZ, so cash-usage evidence for CZ must come from Findex, ČNB, or commercial surveys — and cannot be directly compared to SPACE headline shares without caveats.

negative_findings.description: Czechia is not among the 27 CPMI member jurisdictions whose data populate the current BIS Red Book statistics; the only dedicated CZ Red Book material found is the historic country monograph d25.
negative_findings.result_summary: BIS CPMI pages describe Red Book statistics as covering CPMI member jurisdictions; searches surfaced no current CZ country table in CPMI_FMI or CPMI_CT.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: BIS should be treated as a comparator/benchmark layer for CZ, not a CZ data source. Assuming BIS carries current CZ payment statistics would produce empty or wrong extractions.

negative_findings.description: The ECB PSS (legacy payments and settlement systems) dataset is documented as not browsable through the ECB Data Portal UI — accessible only via the API plus a downloadable series-catalogue CSV.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dataset information page states the dataset is not available via the portal interface and can be accessed only via the ECB Data Portal API.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any UI-based or scraping collection design for long CZ back-series will silently fail; the collector must be API-first and must first ingest the series catalogue to resolve keys.

negative_findings.description: Eurostat dataset isoc_bde15cbc (e-banking and e-commerce) is documented as last updated 31/01/2019 covering 2002-2018.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dataset page metadata shows last update 2019; current equivalents must be located in the isoc_i / isoc_ci dataset families.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pinning a collector to isoc_bde15cbc would produce a frozen series. The correct current Eurostat dataset codes for internet-banking use by individuals still need to be resolved from the isoc_i collection.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching produced essentially no Czech-language supranational statistical sources: cs-language results routed almost entirely to ČNB and ČSÚ national pages rather than to ECB/Eurostat/BIS/IMF/World Bank content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two cs queries returned CNB and CSU pages plus one localised ECB statistics landing page; no Czech-language ECB payments dataset documentation, no Czech BIS/IMF/World Bank material.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The supranational layer for CZ is effectively English-only. Local-language discovery for this cell is best used to find the CZ-side bridge documents (methodology, reporting templates) that explain what is fed upward, not to find the supranational data itself.

negative_findings.description: The IMF FAS entry point could not be pinned to a stable dataset-specific URL from search results; the IMF has migrated its data portal to data.imf.org and older dataservices.imf.org / IMF Data endpoints may be redirected or retired.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned the FAS highlights PDF hosted on data.imf.org and third-party mirrors (DBnomics, FRED, World Bank) rather than a canonical FAS dataset landing URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collector design should not hard-code an IMF FAS API path without first probing; DBnomics/World Bank mirrors are recommended fallbacks. This is a hypothesis about endpoint instability, not a claim that any URL is dead.

negative_findings.description: No official Czech dataset enumerates ATMs operated by independent deployers (IADs). ČNB's payment-statistics commentary explicitly states its ATM figures exclude entities without payment-service authorisation, since operating an ATM is not itself a payment service.
negative_findings.result_summary: IAD estate size (Euronet ~600-700 units per media reporting) exists only in company communications and press, never in official statistics.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any CZ ATM-count series taken from ČNB systematically understates the true estate and misstates the cash-access trend.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Czech for named second-tier independent ATM deployers beyond Euronet (e.g. Cardpay-type operators); no confirmed active Czech IAD brand other than Euronet surfaced in these searches.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Euronet was confirmed as an independent, non-bank ATM deployer with a public Czech presence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cell rationale assumes a plural IAD landscape; on current evidence CZ may be effectively single-IAD, which changes the market-structure conclusion.

negative_findings.description: No Czech trade association for CIT / cash-handling companies (an equivalent of ESTA at EU level) was identified in Czech-language searching during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: CIT actor mapping must be assembled from the ČNB processors register plus individual company filings, not from an association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes the cheapest aggregate source; collection cost for CIT market sizing is correspondingly higher.

negative_findings.description: Financial statements for Loomis Czech Republic a.s., Brink's Cash Solutions (CZ) and G4S Secure Solutions (CZ) exist in Sbírka listin but were not retrieved in this pass; access requires form-driven register queries and the PDFs are frequently scanned images.
negative_findings.result_summary: Filings confirmed to exist by third-party register mirrors; contents unverified here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The only audited CIT revenue figures require an OCR-capable collection step, not a plain HTTP fetch.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched and confirmed live; all URLs are search-derived and carry the confidence score stated per candidate. bankovnikarty.cz vs bankovni-karty.cz appear as two distinct SBK-related hosts and need deterministic disambiguation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness deferred to the verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents false 'verified' claims and flags one likely domain-duplication issue.

negative_findings.description: No Czech payment gateway (GoPay, Comgate, ThePay, PayU CZ, Shoptet Pay, Besteron) was found to publish a recurring, structured statistical report of transaction volumes or payment-method mix. Quantitative figures surface only sporadically inside blog posts, press clippings and journalist interviews.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched cs and en for gateway 'statistiky', 'tisková zpráva', 'objem transakcí'; found only narrative datapoints (e.g. Comgate: QR ~20% of gateway transactions, transfers ~20%; ThePay: ~CZK 7bn processed, ~4,000 merchants).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acceptance-side method mix must be assembled from scattered vendor claims with differing definitions and no methodology, so any resulting series is low-comparability and needs heavy provenance tagging.

negative_findings.description: APEK's flagship E-commerce Study appears to be free for association members only, with non-members getting summaries or paid access; full methodology and payment-method tables may therefore be unavailable to open collection.
negative_findings.result_summary: APEK article headline explicitly states the 2025 E-commerce Study is free for association members.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single best structured survey of Czech online payment-method share may need a membership or purchase decision rather than crawling.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a Czech merchant-side association or gateway consortium publishing aggregated interchange/MSC (merchant service charge) statistics; the only merchant-cost datapoint located was a one-off SOCR ČR internal survey covering seven large chains for 2022.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language searches on 'poplatky za karty obchodník', 'mezibankovní poplatek maloobchod' returned advocacy articles, not a statistical series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Acceptance economics (cost per accepted card transaction) is a core input for POS/terminal market sizing and has no recurring Czech public source.

negative_findings.description: POS/cash-register vendors (Dotykačka, Storyous) hold rich physical-acceptance card-vs-cash data but were not found to publish any aggregate statistics; their public sites are purely product marketing.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language search on 'data z pokladen tržby statistiky karty' returned only product pages, reviews and comparison articles.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Offline retail card-vs-cash mix at SME level remains invisible in this cell without a commercial data partnership.

negative_findings.description: ThePay (thepay.cz) and Besteron CZ (besteron.cz) were identified only through third-party coverage and comparison articles in this pass; their canonical domains and news pages were not directly fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fetch attempted; treated as hypothesis, not as dead or blocked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the named cell actors still need first-party URL confirmation before being added to a collection schedule.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching for a current PwC CZ study on the banking sector or payments ('PwC Česká republika bankovní sektor studie platby report') returned no PwC-authored result — the result set was dominated by Deloitte, KPMG and ČNB pages, with the only PwC mention being a 2011 customer-satisfaction survey cited inside a student thesis.
negative_findings.result_summary: No current PwC CZ banking/payments publication located via cs search; only a 15-year-old secondary citation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: One of the four expected Big Four voices may have little or no public CZ banking/payments output, which changes how much weight the cell can carry; alternatively PwC publishes under Czech titles the seed terms did not match.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language search for EY CZ financial-sector analysis returned only university theses, Deloitte material and ČNB pages — no EY-authored Czech banking study surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: EY CZ banking/payments research not located through cs search terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the Big Four are not equally active on this market; over-generic assumptions about 'PwC/Deloitte/KPMG/EY CZ reports' in the cell definition should be corrected — Deloitte is clearly dominant, EY apparently marginal.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language equivalent search term existed for several international aggregators (Mordor Intelligence, MarketDataForecast, Research and Markets, Statista, GlobalData) — these vendors publish only in English and have no Czech-language surface, so cs-language search cannot reach them.
negative_findings.result_summary: Paid-report vendor layer is English-only; cs search returns nothing for it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language-only monitoring would systematically miss the entire commercial market-sizing layer; the collection design must run parallel en and cs query sets.

negative_findings.description: No joint or CZ-specific McKinsey/BCG/Oliver Wyman payments report for the Czech market was located; the strategy-consultancy layer appears to cover CZ only inside global or European aggregates.
negative_findings.result_summary: Strategy consultancies confirmed present regionally, unconfirmed at CZ country level for payments.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations: for CZ-specific analyst numbers, Deloitte CZ, Raiffeisen Research, Erste and the commercial vendors matter far more than the global strategy houses.

negative_findings.description: Several widely-reported Czech payment-behaviour statistics (three quarters preferring cashless, 58% carrying cash, 71% having abandoned a purchase over card non-acceptance) circulate across many outlets with inconsistent attribution — variously to Česká spořitelna/Europe in Data/Sociologický ústav AV ČR, to STEM/MARK, or to Mastercard — and the originating agency page was not always reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Same figures, multiple claimed originators; primary study pages often not the top search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without resolving the true originating study, downstream analysis risks double-counting one survey as several independent confirmations.

negative_findings.description: The commercially most complete sources in this cell (Statista Czechia digital-payments dossier, GlobalData/Research and Markets cards report, GfK syndicated shopper studies, full Erste and RBI research PDFs) are paywalled, subscription-gated or client-restricted.
negative_findings.result_summary: The richest analyst data in this cell is not freely collectable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection can only capture abstracts and press summaries; a budget decision is needed if the run requires vendor-grade card/POS series.

negative_findings.description: Several URLs in this slice were inferred from standard site patterns rather than returned directly by search: pwc.com/cz/cs.html, ey.com/cs_cz, stemmark.cz, soc.cas.cz/cz/aktuality, and the Deloitte CEE Banking M&A study current-edition URL (only a 2020-edition page was found).
negative_findings.result_summary: Five inferred URLs recorded with reduced confidence pending the deterministic liveness pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These must not be treated as verified; the downstream verification pass should resolve or replace them before they enter the source register as live.

negative_findings.description: No live, distinct web presence was located this run for a CZ title specifically named 'Bankovní inovace'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in Czech for the exact phrase surfaced only the long-running magazine Bankovnictví (bankovnictvionline.cz) and ČNB history pages; 'bankovní inovace' appears to function as a topic phrase rather than a standalone publication.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief names it as a target source; if it is a section/rubric of Bankovnictví rather than a title, collection should be scoped to that magazine instead of hunting a separate domain.

negative_findings.description: The highest-value CZ business titles for market-share and fleet numbers (HN, Ekonom, parts of E15 and Forbes CZ) sit behind subscription walls.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results consistently show premium/member-only markers; full text was not retrieved. This is a hypothesis about access, not a liveness verdict.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection will capture only headlines and leads; the numeric detail that makes these sources uniquely valuable requires paid access or licensed archive (e.g. Anopress/Newton Media style monitoring).

negative_findings.description: No CZ trade-press article found in this run that publishes ATM or POS fleet counts broken down by operator/vendor.
negative_findings.result_summary: Press coverage reliably carries national totals (cards, ATMs, terminals, transactions) sourced from SBK/ČNB, but per-bank ATM fleets and per-acquirer terminal estimates did not surface in open search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-level fleet share, the core A4 need, likely requires executive interviews, tender records, or paid archive search rather than open-web press crawling.

negative_findings.description: The routine playbook file could not be read.
negative_findings.result_summary: The referenced path is a Windows Dropbox path (C:/Users/User/...) and this session runs on macOS; no equivalent local copy was located under the run directory.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Slice was produced from the in-prompt method summary only; field conventions may diverge slightly from the canonical playbook.

negative_findings.description: English-language search returns no CZ trade press, only global report vendors and data aggregators.
negative_findings.result_summary: The English query returned Euromonitor, CEIC, Statista, GlobalData-style vendors plus the ČNB English commentary page — none of them CZ press. Confirms local-language search is the only route into this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Justifies weighting the collection pipeline toward cs-language crawling and warns against relying on English discovery for CZ market-share signals.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'Smart Banking' conference in the Czech Republic was found under that name, despite it being named in the cell definition. Searches in cs and en surfaced Blue Events' portfolio, FinTech Roadmap, Trendy v platebním styku and a Prague-hosted Global Banking Innovation Forum, but no event branded 'Smart Banking'.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cell's 'Smart Banking' reference may conflate MONETA's 'Smart Banka' mobile app (an award-winning product, not an event) with a conference. Recommend treating the payments/fintech events listed above as the substitute set.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a phantom source entering the register and redirects monitoring to the events that actually carry Czech payments agendas.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn — the richest weak-signal channel in this cell — is login-walled and its terms prohibit automated collection. Only individual public post URLs surfaced through search were observable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two public Czech Fintech Association posts were reachable via SERP; no systematic enumeration is possible within terms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline design must budget for manual monitoring of LinkedIn rather than assuming automated capture, or accept the loss of the earliest-signal channel.

negative_findings.description: No consolidated, machine-readable index of Czech bank/PSP job postings exists. Employer ATS instances (KB, ČSOB, Global Payments, Nexi) and aggregators (Indeed CZ, Jobsora, Prace.cz) each hold fragments, and the aggregators are ToS-restricted or bot-defended.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hiring-signal collection must be assembled employer-by-employer from ~10-15 career portals.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for the effort of the hiring-signal workstream and argues for a curated employer list rather than a broad crawl.

negative_findings.description: The Czech Bank Card Association's web estate is split across several legacy domains (bankovnikarty.cz, bankovni-karty.cz, aktuality.bankovnikarty.cz, cardforum.cz, cardsession.com, cardmag.cz) with inconsistent structure and apparently old page templates.
negative_findings.result_summary: Content is present and valuable but the estate is fragmented; no single canonical index of past conference programmes was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A crawler targeting one domain will silently miss most of the association's material; and single 404s on these domains must not be read as the source being dead.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language public register or archive of bank/PSP partnership and pilot announcements was found; such announcements are scattered across issuer newsrooms, scheme newsrooms (Mastercard cs-cz), and trade media (Fintree, Měšec, Peníze.cz, Kurzy.cz).
negative_findings.result_summary: Partnership signals require a multi-newsroom monitoring set rather than one source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects pipeline architecture: needs a fan-out of ~8-12 newsroom feeds plus a Czech-language keyword alert.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found that Radio Prague International or Emerging Europe maintain a dedicated, recurring Czech payments/cards/ATM statistics beat.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only general station/outlet descriptions and occasional one-off items; no payments section or standing series identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: English re-publication of CZ payment statistics is opportunistic, not systematic — the English layer cannot be relied on as a monitoring channel and must be backstopped by Czech-language sources.

negative_findings.description: No search result surfaced a Webarchiv NK ČR thematic collection ('tematická sklizeň') specifically covering banking, finance or payments, nor a direct Webarchiv permalink to archived cnb.cz statistics pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language query returned only Webarchiv's general description pages (webarchiv.cz, nkp.cz) and standardy.ndk.cz documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no finance-themed harvest exists, Webarchiv coverage of retired CZ payment-sector sites may be limited to broad domain crawls with unpredictable depth; a targeted nomination of key sites to Webarchiv may be worth doing.

negative_findings.description: Much of Webarchiv NK ČR is not remotely accessible: archived content is available online only where the publisher granted a licence, otherwise only from National Library terminals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Described by NK ČR/NDK documentation; not tested by fetch in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The national archive cannot be used as an automated collection endpoint; it is a discovery/last-resort layer requiring on-site or licensed access.

negative_findings.description: No public bulk/API endpoint was found for the Sbírka listin document PDFs themselves; dataor.justice.cz exposes register entries (CSV/XML) but the filings appear to remain per-subject PDF downloads via the or.justice.cz UI.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results describe dataor.justice.cz exports of register data and or.justice.cz UI access to the document collection, but no documented filings API.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Systematic financial-statement harvesting for CZ payment firms will need per-IČO scraping plus OCR, or a commercial layer such as Merk — a real cost and a robots/rate-limit compliance question. Unverified; worth a direct check of or.justice.cz robots.txt and terms.

negative_findings.description: Bisnode (now part of Dun & Bradstreet) was returned only as a generic encyclopaedic entry; no current Czech-market product page or access terms for CZ financial-statement data were confirmed in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only a Wikipedia entry surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A major commercial aggregation layer for CZ corporate financials may be under-mapped; requires a follow-up pass on dnb.com CZ offerings.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated CZ open dataset on data.gov.cz combining payment cards, ATM counts or cash-usage shares was located. Searches in Czech using 'platební karty', 'bankomaty', 'hotovost' returned ČNB pages rather than NKOD dataset records.
negative_findings.result_summary: Card/ATM series appear to be produced by ČNB (a different coverage cell), not by the statistical office or ministries; the open-data layer for this cell carries context (retail, ICT, household budgets), not payment-instrument counts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-expecting card/ATM series from ČSÚ or MF; the A4 card/ATM backbone must be sourced from the central-bank cell, with this cell supplying denominators and behavioural context.

negative_findings.description: No standalone ČSÚ survey specifically measuring cash-versus-card payment shares at point of sale was found. The closest official instruments are the household ICT survey (internet banking / online purchasing) and Statistika rodinných účtů (expenditure structure, not tender type).
negative_findings.result_summary: Cash-usage share in CZ appears not to be measured by the statistical office; it is inferred from ČNB currency-in-circulation data or from private studies.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Signals a structural gap: 'cash usage' as a topic cannot be fully served from national statistical infrastructure and will need central-bank plus commercial/industry sources.

negative_findings.description: The DataStat API endpoint pattern (https://data.csu.gov.cz/api/dotaz/v1/data/vybery/{code}) and the data.gov.cz SPARQL endpoint (https://data.gov.cz/sparql) were identified from official documentation but were not exercised in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Endpoints documented, not tested by this analyst; liveness and rate limits unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must confirm these before a harvester is built; a failure would push collection back to brittle HTML/JSF scraping.

negative_findings.description: ČSÚ has migrated from czso.cz to csu.gov.cz, and MF ČR from mfcr.cz to mf.gov.cz. Both old and new hostnames still return content in search results, with some deep links (e.g. VDB at vdb.czso.cz) still on the legacy domain.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dual-domain estate; legacy URLs may redirect, mirror, or eventually 404.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any URL registry for this cell must store both hostnames and treat a single 404 on a legacy path as a migration hypothesis rather than a dead source.

negative_findings.description: ČBA does not expose an obvious top-level statistics/analyses index on cbaonline.cz. https://www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/analyzy returns 'Stránka nenalezena' (404), and https://www.cbaonline.cz/statistika resolves to what reads as a glossary definition of 'statistika' rather than a data index. The substantive recurring data lives on the separate cbamonitor.cz property, and survey/report pages sit at flat slugs (e.g. /cesi-a-platebni-styk-2021) reachable mainly via search.
negative_findings.result_summary: No single ČBA publications archive URL identified; collection must go via cbamonitor.cz plus sitemap/site-search-driven discovery on cbaonline.cz.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A link-walking crawler pointed at cbaonline.cz will silently miss the survey series; the collector needs a search- or sitemap-driven strategy and should not conclude the reports do not exist.

negative_findings.description: The ČBA 'Češi a platební styk' payment-behaviour survey was found for 2019, 2020 and 2021 only. Searches did not surface 2022-2026 editions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Series may have been discontinued, renamed, or moved behind a different slug pattern; not confirmed either way.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If discontinued, the demand-side cash-vs-card view for CZ must be sourced elsewhere (ČNB, ECB SPACE study, APEK). Treat as an open question, not as evidence the series is dead.

negative_findings.description: The cell brief names 'SČS/AKAT'. In Czech financial usage SČS most commonly expands to 'Sdružení českých spotřebitelů' (Czech Consumer Association), which is a consumer body, not a capital-market one; AKAT is 'Asociace pro kapitálový trh ČR'. Searching SČS together with card/acquiring terms returned no card-market association by that acronym — it instead surfaced SBK (Sdružení pro bankovní karty), which is the genuine card body.
negative_findings.result_summary: SČS treated as a probable brief-side conflation; AKAT covered fully, and SBK added as the card-sector body the brief appears to have been reaching for.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream collector from chasing a non-existent 'SČS' payments association, and flags that SBK — arguably the single highest-value source in this cell — was not named in the brief at all.

negative_findings.description: https://www.clfa.cz/spolecnosti and https://www.cbaonline.cz/o-nas/analyzy both returned 404s on fetch. In the ČLFA case the site's own navigation points to /o-nas/clenske-spolecnosti as the real directory, and individual company pages under /spolecnosti/<id>-<slug> do resolve in search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are path-guess misses, not dead sources.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Records these URLs as wrong-path hypotheses so a later verification pass does not mark ČLFA's member directory as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: The Czech Fintech Association member grid at czechfintech.cz/en/clenove/ renders only a handful of logos in static HTML behind a 'Zobrazit dalších více jak 80 členů' expander.
negative_findings.result_summary: Full 80+ member roster not obtainable by plain HTTP fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The most complete CZ fintech/PSP actor enumeration requires headless rendering or the underlying data feed; a static crawler would report ~5 members and badly understate the ecosystem.

negative_findings.description: No Czech trade association dedicated specifically to ATM operating/deployment (independent ATM deployers) or to POS terminal estate was found. ATM and POS terminal counts appear only as metrics inside SBK's card statistics, and terminal/POS vendors appear only as ordinary members inside the Czech Fintech Association and SBK's observer list.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM/POS infrastructure has no standalone CZ trade body in this cell's coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms SBK is the only association-level route to ATM/POS estate data in CZ; anything more granular must come from the regulator (ČNB) or commercial sources, which are outside this cell.

negative_findings.description: ASPPS (Asociace poskytovatelů platebních služeb ČR, aspps.eu, IČO 04387783) surfaced only via a registry mirror and a bare http URL; no statistics or member list was observed, and its activity level could not be established in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate with low credibility/confidence rather than dropped, because it is the only body found that is specifically a PSP association.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If active, it would fill the one structural gap in this cell — non-bank payment institutions have no other association home. Warrants a manual check before investing collection effort.

negative_findings.description: No Visa- or Mastercard-published Czech Republic 'country factsheet' with recurring transaction volumes was located. Schemes disclose CZ interchange (because the IFR compels them) but publish CZ volumes only episodically inside marketing press releases, never as a maintained statistical series.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched cs and en for scheme country factsheets / CZ volume reporting; found press releases and interchange PDFs only, no periodic CZ data product.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: CZ scheme-level volume series cannot be built by subscription to a single scheme page; it must be reconstructed press-release by press-release, with all the selection bias that implies.

negative_findings.description: Neither Visa nor Mastercard publishes its own scheme-fee (as distinct from interchange) schedule for the Czech Republic. Scheme fees sit outside the IFR caps and are disclosed, if at all, by acquirers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search for scheme-fee disclosures returned acquirer/PSP documents (Worldline CZ, Paybyrd) and explainer articles; no scheme-published CZ scheme-fee schedule.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Scheme-fee economics for CZ can only be triangulated from acquirer indicative rate cards, which are indicative and vendor-specific — a permanent accuracy ceiling on cost-of-acceptance analysis.

negative_findings.description: Diners Club ceased issuing in the Czech Republic (and Slovakia, Poland) as of 2 August 2022 by decision of its Austrian owner; card payment functionality was blocked the following day. Amex has likewise wound consumer/business issuance down in CZ, with acceptance handled since 2013 by Global Payments Europe.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language searches on Diners and Amex returned exit reporting rather than active CZ scheme operations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the five named schemes in this cell are effectively acceptance-only or absent in CZ; scouting effort should be weighted heavily toward Visa, Mastercard and UnionPay, and Diners/Amex sources treated as historical/residual.

negative_findings.description: No Czech-language versions were found for the interchange and scheme-rulebook disclosures — Visa CZ interchange PDFs are hosted in English on visa.co.uk, Mastercard's CZ file (11Czech.pdf) and both rulebooks are English-only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language queries on 'mezibankovní poplatek / interchange sazby Česká republika' surfaced no scheme-hosted cs documents; only en PDFs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring alone will miss the single most quantitative scheme disclosure category for CZ; the collection plan must run English crawls on visa.co.uk and mastercard.com regardless of the cs/en language scope.

negative_findings.description: The visa.cz newsroom index returned only page chrome (title/header) with no press-release listing on a plain fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: WebFetch of https://www.visa.cz/o-spolecnosti-visa/newsroom/press-releases.html produced header only; individual numbered release URLs found via search do resolve in search indexes.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis of client-side rendering, not evidence the source is dead — a headless browser or the Mynewsdesk/ČTK mirrors are required. Do not mark visa.cz as unreachable on this basis.

negative_findings.description: No JCB country page, JCB CZ acceptance statistic, or JCB–Czech acquirer announcement was located in this pass, in either language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query on JCB acceptance in CZ returned only generic PSP payment-method pages and a pan-European PayXpert partnership item with no CZ figures.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: JCB's CZ footprint remains uncharacterised; if inbound-tourism payment flows matter to the brief, this is an open hole requiring a dedicated pass on JCB's Japanese-language and European corporate sites.

negative_findings.description: No public, machine-readable dataset was found giving QR Platba/SPAYD usage volumes (number of QR-initiated payments) at national level.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs searches returned the standard text, bank implementation specs and generators, but no adoption metrics; QR-payment counts appear only anecdotally in bank PR.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: QR-initiated payment volume is a CZ-specific adoption indicator with no substitute in ECB/BIS datasets; absence means it must be proxied from bank disclosures or SBK data.

negative_findings.description: No standing operator-published statistics page found for MONETA / ČSOB scheme-rail activity equivalent to Bank iD's or SBK's; figures surface only inside periodic investor reports and press releases.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced KB investor-relations pages and press coverage of ČSOB Smart user counts, but no dedicated recurring rail-statistics publication.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Bank-level rail metrics must be extracted from PDFs on a quarterly cycle rather than pulled from a stable statistics endpoint, raising collection cost and latency.

negative_findings.description: 'Monet+' (Czech smart-card/e-ID technology vendor) could not be confirmed as a card-payment processing operator in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: The cs query naming Monet+ returned only Global Payments and Worldline material; no result substantiated a processing role.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids inventing an actor; Monet+ should be re-checked as a possible e-ID/authentication technology supplier rather than a rail operator.

negative_findings.description: The CERTIS statistics subpage was observed on the mirror host cnbprovsechny.cnb.cz; the equivalent path on the main www.cnb.cz host was not directly fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hub fetch confirmed a statistics section exists; canonical main-host URL is inferred, not verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection config should resolve the canonical URL before scheduling, or it may silently pull from a mirror.

negative_findings.description: No CZ systemic bank was found publishing POS acquiring volumes (merchant turnover, terminal counts) as a recurring disclosed metric.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on acquiring/terminal terms surfaced only card-issuing and ATM figures; acquiring in CZ largely sits with separate entities (e.g. Global Payments, Worldline joint ventures) rather than being reported in bank annual reports.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Route (b) actor-level POS data cannot be reconstructed from bank IR alone; a separate acquirer/PSP cell is required.

negative_findings.description: Standalone Pillar 3 / CRR disclosure documents were not individually located for ČS, UniCredit CZ or Raiffeisenbank CZ within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both cs and en queries returned the general mandatory-disclosure hubs and annual reports instead of discrete Pillar 3 files; they are likely embedded in annual reports or behind JS-driven document tabs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 rarely contains card/ATM operational data anyway, but its absence should be recorded rather than assumed; a targeted deep-crawl of each disclosure hub is needed.

negative_findings.description: PPF Group does not appear to publish an Air Bank operational breakout (cards, ATMs) separate from Air Bank's own consolidated annual report.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs search on PPF + Air Bank statistics returned media coverage and Air Bank's own PDFs only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Air Bank/Fio coverage depends entirely on their own annual PDFs, so cadence for these actors is annual, not quarterly.

negative_findings.description: The KB investor-relations landing URL and the RBI investor URL were inferred from site structure and group ownership, not confirmed by a fetched page in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results for KB IR returned social accounts and third-party transcripts rather than the kb.cz IR page itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These two entries must be treated as hypotheses for the deterministic liveness pass; do not record them as dead if they 404 — find the current path from the site navigation.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searches for hardware-OEM reference or case-study pages (Ingenico, PAX, Verifone) returned no CZ-localised customer-reference pages from the OEMs themselves. All Czech-language hits were acquirer catalogues, accessory resellers and user manuals rather than vendor references.
negative_findings.result_summary: OEM customer references for CZ appear to exist only in English on global sites, if at all; the CZ evidence trail runs through acquirer product pages and manuals instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Terminal-OEM share in CZ cannot be read off vendor marketing and must be inferred indirectly from acquirer hardware catalogues, manuals and accessory listings - a slower, fingerprint-based method.

negative_findings.description: The Czech term 'personalizace' plus 'karty' is heavily polluted by retail marketing about personalised virtual card designs (MONETA campaigns), swamping results about industrial card production and personalisation bureaux.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only one genuine supply-chain hit (Monet+ chip-card production page) surfaced; the rest were consumer card-design press releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Future queries on card issuance supply chain should use narrower Czech terms such as 'výroba čipových karet', 'personalizační centrum', 'embosing' and avoid bare 'personalizace karet'.

negative_findings.description: No press release was found linking Nexi/Nets to Ceska sporitelna acquiring or processing. Nexi Central Europe states Czech Republic coverage generally, but no named CZ bank customer was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Nexi CZ presence is asserted at group level only; specific CZ bank mandates remain unidentified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The CZ processing landscape cannot yet be fully attributed between Global Payments Europe, Nexi Central Europe and in-house/bank-owned units such as BANIT; leaving this open risks mis-sizing the addressable processing market.

negative_findings.description: No press release or public statement with installed-terminal counts was found for Dotypay/Dotykacka SoftPOS in CZ despite targeted Czech-language searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: Domestic POS vendors publicise product features and subsidy participation but not fleet size.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: SoftPOS/Android-terminal penetration in CZ will have to be approximated from the MPO 'Cesko plati kartou' scheme statistics and acquirer disclosures rather than vendor claims.

negative_findings.description: Czech-language searching on ATM outsourcing and self-service network management for CZ banks returned consumer-facing locator and explainer content, not supplier contracts. The only quantified outsourcing evidence found came from the vendor side (Diebold Nixdorf's CSOB case study).
negative_findings.result_summary: Demand-side disclosure of ATM outsourcing is effectively absent in Czech; supply-side vendor material is the only route.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's core rationale: vendor publications, not bank publications, are the viable channel for CZ self-service procurement intelligence, and single-sourced vendor claims will need triangulation.

negative_findings.description: No public tender route exists for the ATM estates of commercial Czech banks (Česká spořitelna, ČSOB, Komerční banka, Moneta, Air Bank, UniCredit, Raiffeisenbank). They are private entities not covered by Act 134/2016 Sb., so their ATM supply, cash-in-transit and processing contracts are not published in VVZ/NEN/TED.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language searches for 'veřejná zakázka bankomaty' returned only ČNB/state records and ÚOHS competition material, no bank-issued tender notices.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The largest share of Czech ATM and acquiring volume is therefore invisible to this workstream; A4 tender routes cover the state, post, transport and municipal segment only, and bank-side numbers must come from ČNB statistics or ÚOHS/merger filings instead.

negative_findings.description: Attempts to reach a specific Czech Post tender for cash/valuables transport via Tender Arena search did not surface such a contract; only unrelated Czech Post contracts (mobile apps, handling equipment, barcode readers) appeared.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two TED notices for Czech Post (486371-2020, 525527-2020) were surfaced as PDFs but their subject matter was not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Czech Post is the single most important non-bank cash node in CZ; failure to locate its cash-logistics tenders is a coverage risk, not evidence that none exist.

negative_findings.description: No fetch of TED, NEN, VVZ, Tender Arena or E-ZAK pages was performed in this pass; all URLs come from search results only and none is claimed reachable. TED and Tender Arena in particular are known to be JavaScript-heavy and may return 403 or empty shells to simple fetchers.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should assume an API/bulk-download route for TED and NEN rather than HTML scraping.

negative_findings.description: No settled Czech-language term was identified for 'cash recycler' or 'deposit-taking ATM' beyond the colloquial 'vkladomat'; 'bankomat' is used broadly and 'vkladomat' appears mostly in consumer media rather than tender language.
negative_findings.result_summary: Tender-grade phrasing for recycling ATMs remains unresolved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword monitoring may miss recycler tenders phrased as 'zařízení pro zpracování bankovek' or by CPV code only.

negative_findings.description: No open, unauthenticated bulk download of the CZ licence register (JERRS) was found. The only documented machine interface, WS JERRS, requires a commercial qualified certificate from eIdentity, I.CA, PostSignum or an EU trust-list CA.
negative_findings.result_summary: Machine access to the authoritative CZ register is gated behind certificate-based authentication; the EBA PSD2 register is the only free bulk substitute and covers PIs/EMIs only, not small-scale providers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Long-term automated tracking of the full CZ payment-actor population either needs a certificate procurement decision or must fall back to HTML scraping of JERRS.

negative_findings.description: No regulatory register in this cell enumerates ATM or POS terminal estates. Searches surfaced ATM facts only incidentally inside ÚOHS merger and press material (e.g. an ATM count for one banking group) and inside the ÚOHS interbank ATM-withdrawal fee file.
negative_findings.result_summary: ATM/POS counts are not a registered attribute in CZ; they appear only as adversarial disclosure in competition files or in statistical series outside this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM/POS estate data must be sourced from ČNB payment statistics or industry bodies, not from licence registers; the cell can only contribute episodic case-file evidence.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated, permanently maintained ÚOHS index of interchange/card cases was found; the payments topic page and the general Sbírka rozhodnutí search form are the only routes, and the specific historical interbank ATM-fee decision was seen only via a summarised search result rather than a directly identified case URL.
negative_findings.result_summary: Interchange and ATM-fee cases must be retrieved by keyword query rather than from a stable curated list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must rely on repeated keyword querying and the related-decision link graph, with the risk of missing older or differently worded cases.

negative_findings.description: Two cell sources appear under two live domains each: the Ministry of Finance (mfcr.cz legacy assets vs mf.gov.cz current) and the Financial Arbitrator (finarbitr.cz vs finarbitr.gov.cz).
negative_findings.result_summary: Both domain variants returned results; which is canonical was not established and is not asserted here.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Stored URLs may silently rot or duplicate; the collector should canonicalise to the .gov.cz variants and keep the legacy domain as a fallback rather than treating a legacy 404 as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: The appellate layer over ÚOHS and ČNB decisions (Krajský soud v Brně, Nejvyšší správní soud judgment databases) was identified conceptually as the natural snowball target but was not searched within this run's budget.
negative_findings.result_summary: Court judgment databases remain an unexplored pointer source for this cell.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Judgments often restate the factual and economic findings of quashed or contested regulatory decisions, sometimes in more detail than the redacted originals.

coverage_gaps.description: ČNB publishes only national aggregates for cards, ATMs and POS terminals; no issuer-, acquirer- or scheme-level breakdown and no merchant-category detail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cover this from adjacent cells: card schemes (Visa/Mastercard CZ), acquirers, the Czech Banking Association, and individual bank annual reports; use ČNB aggregates as the control total.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment statistics are quarterly/semi-annual with a substantial publication lag, whereas CERTIS volumes are monthly. Card and terminal counts therefore update far more slowly than transaction volumes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Anchor high-frequency tracking on CERTIS and instant-payment releases; treat card/ATM/POS counts as a semi-annual structural update and document the lag explicitly in every derived metric.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment statistics were re-based in 2022 following ECB Reg. (EU) 2020/2011 and CZ Decree 401/2021 Sb., with new report codes and a new coding scheme for payments. Pre-2022 and post-2022 series are not automatically comparable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Record the 2022 break as a hard boundary in the series metadata; retain the ČNB methodology pages as the citation, and avoid joining pre/post-2022 series without an explicit bridge.

coverage_gaps.description: ARAD is a JavaScript SPA with hash routing; the underlying REST API surface, indicator identifiers and rate limits have not been enumerated in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicate an engineering spike to parsing the ARAD-REST-API PDF and enumerating the payment-statistics and currency-in-circulation set/indicator IDs before building the collector.

coverage_gaps.description: The English mirror of cnb.cz was confirmed to exist for the main statistics, CERTIS and payments pages, but English mirrors were not located for the deeper methodology and reporting pages (vykazování, metodické poznámky) or for the cnBlog cash posts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Collect the Czech originals as authoritative for methodology; do not rely on English mirrors for reporting-framework detail, and note where an English version may lag or be absent.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-usage evidence from ČNB is supply-side (currency in circulation, denominations, counterfeits). ČNB payment-diary or consumer cash-behaviour survey material was not located in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search specifically for ČNB/ECB SPACE-style consumer payment-behaviour studies for CZ in a follow-up, and cover demand-side cash behaviour from survey cells.

coverage_gaps.description: Exact ECB Data Portal series keys for Czechia POS terminals, ATMs, card counts and card transaction values were not enumerated in this pass — only the dataset and category level was established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Download the PAY and PSS series-catalogue CSVs from the ECB Data Portal, filter REF_AREA=CZ, and register the resolved series keys as first-class sources before any collection run.

coverage_gaps.description: The break between the pre-2022 ECB PSS regime and the post-2022 PAY regime under Regulation (EU) 2020/2011 is known to exist but its concrete effect on CZ terminal and card series has not been characterised.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair the ECB PAY/PSS pull with the ČNB Czech-language methodological commentary and the ECB regulation text to build an explicit break table before any multi-year trend claim is made.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-ECB European supranational layers were not exhausted: OECD statistics, the European Commission/DG FISMA PSD2 review evidence base, ESRB, and EU open-data portal (data.europa.eu) mirrors of payments data were not searched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on data.europa.eu, OECD Data Explorer, and DG FISMA PSD2/PSR impact-assessment annexes for CZ-broken-out payments evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: No supranational source found that measures CZ cash usage at point of sale in a harmonised, behaviour-level way (SPACE excludes CZ; BIS excludes CZ; Findex measures account/digital-payment use rather than POS payment shares).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat CZ POS cash share as a national-source-only indicator (ČNB, commercial surveys) and flag the absence explicitly in any comparative deliverable; consider Findex digital-payment indicators as the only comparable proxy.

coverage_gaps.description: Only two Czech-language queries were run within this cell and both resolved to national rather than supranational material; Czech terminology for supranational dataset concepts (e.g. akceptační místa, platební terminály, harmonizovaná statistika) remains only partially mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the cs glossary with terminal/acceptance vocabulary (platební terminál, akceptační místo, bezhotovostní platby, hotovostní platby, výběry z bankomatů) and re-run cs discovery specifically against ČNB/ČSÚ bridge documents that cite ECB/Eurostat datasets.

coverage_gaps.description: Redistribution and licensing terms were inferred rather than read for IMF FAS, BIS and Findex microdata.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and record the terms-of-use pages for data.imf.org, data.bis.org and the World Bank Microdata Library before any internal or client-facing republication of extracted values.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash-in-transit actor map is incomplete: only Loomis, Brink's and G4S were confirmed. Smaller regional processors licensed under Act 136/2011 are not yet enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the full ČNB list of 'zpracovatelé tuzemských bankovek a mincí' via JERRS/open data and treat every entry as a candidate actor to profile.

coverage_gaps.description: No municipality-level dataset of ATM/branch presence was located; evidence is anecdotal (individual town closures) or aggregated nationally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test ČSÚ / Ministerstvo financí and open-data portals (data.gov.cz) for financial-service accessibility layers; check Czech Banking Association (ČBA) for a branch-network dataset.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech Banking Association (Česká bankovní asociace, ČBA) was not directly searched in this pass despite being the most likely publisher of branch/cash-desk aggregates and cash-usage surveys.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated pass on cbaonline.cz for statistics, position papers on cash accessibility and the ČBA/Ipsos payment-habits survey.

coverage_gaps.description: No EU-level comparator source was captured (ECB SPACE-type cash-usage studies, ESTA CIT industry data, EPC cash reports) to benchmark CZ against euro-area cash trends.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an English-language pass on ECB payments statistics, ECB cash studies and ESTA publications, filtering for CZ or CEE coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: No paid/commercial dataset vendors (RBR/Datos ATM benchmarking, Euromonitor, ATM Marketplace intelligence) were assessed for CZ ATM-estate coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scope RBR Global ATM Market and Forecasts and similar vendor products for CZ line items, and record licence/cost constraints.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-owned and international acquirers serving Czech merchants (Global Payments CZ / KB SmartPay, Worldline, Nexi, ČSOB, Komerční banka, Air Bank's 'Cvak' A2A scheme, Adyen CZ) were not individually scouted in this pass, although Comgate's disclosures show Cvak is already material.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated acquirer/A2A sweep in cs: 'KB SmartPay statistiky', 'Global Payments Česko akceptace karet', 'Worldline Česko terminály', 'Cvak Air Bank platby e-shop objem'.

coverage_gaps.description: Large individual merchants that disclose payment-mix or basket statistics (Alza, Rohlik, Mall/Allegro CZ, Notino, Dr.Max) were not covered; their annual reports and PR can carry acceptance-side datapoints.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sweep top-20 Czech e-shops' press rooms and annual reports for payment-method and AOV disclosures.

coverage_gaps.description: Official statistical and regulatory anchors for the acceptance side (ČSÚ e-commerce/retail statistics, ČNB payment-system statistics, Eurostat ICT usage) were deliberately out of this cell but are needed to normalise the commercial claims collected here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another cell covers ČSÚ/ČNB/Eurostat, and cross-link so gateway and association figures can be reconciled to official denominators.

coverage_gaps.description: Most acceptance-side quantitative claims found are point-in-time PR statements without back-series; only Heureka's quarterly Insider offers a genuinely repeating time series.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the Heureka Insider series first as the spine, then attach dated gateway/association datapoints to it with explicit provenance and definition notes.

coverage_gaps.description: Access and licensing terms were not verified for the two most valuable structured portals (data.apek.cz and ceska-ecommerce.cz), nor were their underlying data endpoints inspected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch both portals, inspect network calls for JSON endpoints, and read their ToS/robots.txt before scheduling automated collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech-domiciled boutique financial analysts and consultancies covering payments (e.g. local fintech advisory shops, bank-owned analytical teams beyond Raiffeisen and Erste, and the analytical units of KB/ČSOB/ČS) were not systematically enumerated in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs-language sweep on 'analytický tým banky', 'makroanalytici', 'ekonomické analýzy' plus each major CZ bank name to map bank-side research desks publishing payments commentary.

coverage_gaps.description: Analyst coverage specifically of ATM networks and cash-in-transit economics in CZ was not found in this cell — the found aggregator reports address POS terminals, cards and e-commerce, but not ATM estate sizing or cash-cycle cost analysis.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted searches on 'bankomaty počet Česko analýza', 'ATM network outsourcing CEE report', and vendor/ATM-operator commissioned studies; also check independent ATM deployer market commentary.

coverage_gaps.description: Paid-report distributor and abstract aggregators beyond the ones found (e.g. ReportLinker, MarketResearch.com, EMIS/ISI Emerging Markets, Euromonitor Passport, GlobalData's own portal) were not enumerated, yet they are the standard route to CZ payment market abstracts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate distributor platforms and set up saved searches on 'Czech Republic' + cards/payments/POS to catch every new edition abstract regardless of publisher.

coverage_gaps.description: Most consumer-survey evidence found dates to 2022–2024 waves; whether these series continued into 2025–2026 was not established for STEM/MARK, GfK CZ or the Index prosperity payment chapter.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check each series' latest edition explicitly and record publication cadence in the source register so staleness is detectable.

coverage_gaps.description: The regional bank-research layer (RBI, Erste) was reached only in English; whether Czech-language versions of the CEE Banking Sector Report or Czech-desk notes exist for local audiences was not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search cs terms such as 'Raiffeisen Research zpráva o bankovním sektoru střední Evropy' and check csas.cz / rb.cz analytical sections for Czech-language editions.

coverage_gaps.description: Card-scheme-commissioned research (Mastercard CZ, Visa CZ press studies) appeared repeatedly in the media layer as a source of Czech payment-behaviour statistics but sits at the boundary of this cell and was not catalogued here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm which cell owns scheme-commissioned research; if unowned, add Mastercard/Visa CZ newsrooms as first-class sources — they are among the most prolific publishers of CZ payment-behaviour numbers.

coverage_gaps.description: No licensed CZ press-archive/monitoring service is in scope, yet HN/Ekonom/E15 full text is where fleet and share figures actually appear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate a CZ media-monitoring archive (e.g. Newton Media / Anopress class services) or direct HN+Ekonom subscriptions for full-text retrospective search on terms like 'bankomat', 'platební terminál', 'podíl na trhu'.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak-language and cross-border CZ/SK trade press was not covered in this cell, though CZ-SK vendor deals are often reported only on the Slovak side.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a companion sweep of SK business press (Trend, Hospodárske noviny SK, Živé.sk) for CZ-relevant vendor and fleet mentions.

coverage_gaps.description: Only text web media were scouted; CZ banking/payments podcasts, conference recordings and video interviews were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout CZ finance podcasts and conference programmes (e.g. Bankovnictví-organised events, CzechCrunch/Lupa video formats) where executives state fleet and share numbers aloud.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was confirmed reachable by fetch; all entries rest on search-result evidence only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass; treat any 403/timeout as bot defence rather than a dead source, and re-check 404s for moved URLs.

coverage_gaps.description: Most press figures trace back to two primaries (SBK — Sdružení pro bankovní karty, and ČNB payment statistics) not owned by this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another cell registers SBK (cardzone.cz / bankovnikarty.cz) and ČNB ARAD payment series as direct sources so press items can be deduplicated against them.

coverage_gaps.description: Career portals were confirmed for KB, ČSOB, Global Payments Europe, Worldline and Nexi, but not yet for Česká spořitelna, Raiffeisenbank, Air Bank/Moneta, UniCredit CZ, Fio, Partners Banka, or for local terminal/processor players (Sonet, Monet+, Twisto/Zonky-type fintechs).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the ČNB list of licensed banks and payment institutions and resolve each to its careers URL, building a fixed employer watchlist for hiring signals.

coverage_gaps.description: Only fragments of historic conference agendas were located (cardforum 2022 PDF, cardforum 2024 write-up). No systematic multi-year agenda archive was found for any Czech payments event.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Back-fill via web.archive.org snapshots of cardforum.cz, retailsummit.cz/program and konferenceseminare.cz to build a 5-10 year agenda-topic time series — the topic drift is the actual leading indicator.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-LinkedIn social/community weak-signal channels were not explored: X/Twitter accounts (e.g. @Card_Forum surfaced but was not assessed), Czech fintech podcasts, YouTube recordings of conference sessions, and Slack/Discord-style practitioner communities.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on X, YouTube and podcast platforms with cs terms ('platební styk', 'platební karty', 'okamžité platby') to identify recorded-session archives, which often outlive the event page.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash usage and ATM estate signals are thin in this cell: no cash-handling/ATM-operator conference, award or hiring channel was identified (e.g. Euronet CZ, cash-in-transit operators, ČNB cash-cycle events).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted cs sweep on 'hotovost', 'bankomat', 'samoobslužná zóna', 'zpracování hotovosti' across job boards and event calendars to close the cash/ATM weak-signal gap.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetch-verified; all reachability assessments are inferences from search-result metadata. Several legacy SBK domains and retired event pages are plausible 404/moved candidates.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass over every URL; on failure classify 403/timeout as bot-defended-but-live and 404 as moved, and attempt an archive.org lookup before marking anything dead.

coverage_gaps.description: No mechanism identified yet that proactively captures ČNB/ČSÚ payment-statistics pages at the moment of publication, so restructuring risk is only partly mitigated by opportunistic Wayback crawls.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a scheduled job: poll ČNB RSS, and on any statistics/methodology item POST the URL to the Wayback 'save page now' endpoint plus store a local copy of the dataset file.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell established the registry infrastructure (ARES, dataor, or.justice.cz) but did not yet enumerate the specific CZ payment-sector legal entities (acquirers, ATM independent deployers, cash-in-transit, POS vendors, payment institutions) whose filings should be tracked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross ČNB's registry of payment institutions and e-money issuers against ARES NACE codes (64.19, 66.19, 82.99) to produce a tracked IČO list, then schedule annual Sbírka listin pulls each October (filings due 30 September).

coverage_gaps.description: The English-language re-publication layer is dominated by one consumer outlet (Expats.cz); ČTK's English wire — the likely main channel — is subscription-gated and was not accessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate a ČTK English service subscription or at least map which CZ payment stories reach it; add Brno Daily / Prague Morning as additional English candidates in a follow-up pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Newsletter-format aggregators (Czech fintech/banking newsletters, LinkedIn-native digests) were not covered; only RSS-based aggregation was mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on 'newsletter fintech Česko', 'bankovní newsletter odběr' and Substack/Ecomail-hosted CZ finance digests.

coverage_gaps.description: robots.txt, rate limits and terms of use were not inspected for or.justice.cz, dataor.justice.cz, ares.gov.cz or web.archive.org in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a compliance check step before any automated collection against these hosts; record allowed crawl rates per host.

coverage_gaps.description: Point-of-sale tender mix (cash vs card vs mobile wallet) is not covered by any national statistical or ministry source identified in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign to central-bank and industry-association cells (ČNB payment statistics, SBK/bankovnikarty.cz, acquirer and retail-association studies); consider Eurostat/ECB SPACE study as a comparative fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: Digitální a informační agentura (DIA), the operator of data.gov.cz and gov.cz service catalogue, was not directly profiled; nor were subordinate MF bodies (Celní správa, Generální finanční ředitelství) as individual open-data publishers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass over NKOD publisher facets to enumerate every CZ public-sector publisher with finance/retail themed datasets, and profile DIA as the institutional owner of the open-data stack.

coverage_gaps.description: Microdata access routes were not investigated: ČSÚ anonymised microdata (SRÚ, SILC, ICT surveys) are available only under a formal request/contract procedure that was not documented in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Document the ČSÚ microdata request procedure, pricing and confidentiality conditions before any analysis that needs household-level payment or expenditure detail.

coverage_gaps.description: English coverage of this cell is thin: only 'Information Society in Figures' and the MPO portal English mirror were confirmed. Most ministry and open-data material is Czech-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Czech-language extraction (cs NLP / translation in the pipeline) rather than relying on English mirrors, which lag and omit annexes.

coverage_gaps.description: Release calendars were not captured. ČSÚ 'Rychlé informace' publish on a fixed schedule and MF reports annually mid-year, but exact dates were not collected.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the ČSÚ katalog produktů release calendar and MF publication plan to schedule collection instead of polling blindly.

coverage_gaps.description: No association was found representing merchant acquirers or payment-terminal operators as a distinct group, and none representing independent ATM deployers. SBK's observer list is the closest proxy but its composition was not directly verified in this pass (the mirror host failed TLS).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch https://www.bankovnikarty.cz/pages/czech/o_sbk_statut.html and the činnost page directly on the bankovnikarty.cz host (which fetched successfully) to extract the observer list; cross-reference against the ČNB register of payment institutions to identify acquirers with no association home.

coverage_gaps.description: SBK claims card statistics from 2000 to 2026 plus a historical Excel from 1989, but the exact download URL pattern under /statistiky/download/ was inferred from relative paths rather than confirmed file-by-file.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a directory/index enumeration pass over the SBK statistics download area to pin the exact filename convention (sbk_statistika_<period>_<year>.pdf/xls) and build a complete back-catalogue manifest before starting incremental collection.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language association output is thin: only czech-ba.cz/en, apek.cz/en and ČLFA's English-titled quarterly results page were found. SBK, AKAT, APNÚ, AČSS and the fintech association publish substantively in Czech only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Plan for Czech-language extraction and translation in the collection pipeline for this cell; do not scope an English-only collector. Maintain the CS glossary (statistiky, členové/členské společnosti, zveřejněná data, tisková zpráva, bezhotovostní platby, dobírka, výběry z bankomatů, objem financování) as the crawl vocabulary.

coverage_gaps.description: APEK's annual E-commerce Study — the richest association source on e-commerce payment mix and cash-on-delivery decline — is free to members and presumably paid otherwise. Only press-release-level figures are openly available. APNÚ's new credit register is likewise presumably members-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide whether to acquire the APEK study through legitimate purchase/membership rather than scraping; in the interim collect the free /clanky payment-method releases and data.apek.cz as a lower-resolution substitute.

coverage_gaps.description: Several adjacent CZ bodies were not searched in this pass for time reasons: Česká asociace pojišťoven (insurance, for bancassurance/insurtech overlap), Asociace družstevních záložen / kampeliček (credit unions), any CZ crypto-asset industry association (relevant post-MiCA for payments), and Hospodářská komora ČR sectoral sections.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up sweep on 'Česká asociace pojišťoven statistiky', 'družstevní záložny asociace', 'asociace kryptoměn ČR', and 'Hospodářská komora finanční sekce' to close the association map.

coverage_gaps.description: AČSS explicitly states its statistics derive from the Ministry of Finance, and several association aggregates may similarly re-publish ČNB or ministry data with association framing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each association series, record provenance explicitly (association-collected from members vs. re-published official data) so downstream analysis does not treat a re-publication as an independent corroborating source.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme press releases are the only source of CZ volume/penetration figures, and older releases are periodically pruned from scheme CMSs (2015-2019 Visa Europe CZ contactless figures now survive mainly in third-party media).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every scheme-newsroom crawl with a Wayback Machine backfill of the cs-cz and visa.cz press paths, and archive the Czech media relays (kurzy.cz, e15, retailnews) that quote the original figures.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme CZ figures are routinely attributed to Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK/SDKB, the Czech Bank Card Association) rather than produced independently by the scheme — the association is the upstream aggregator for much of what Visa/Mastercard quote locally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure SBK (bankovnikarty.cz) is scouted in the associations cell and cross-linked here, so scheme-quoted numbers can be traced to their actual origin and double-counting avoided.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme-fee and cost-of-acceptance evidence for CZ rests on a single acquirer document (Worldline). No comparison set exists yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Collect equivalent CZ indicative scheme-fee / merchant pricing disclosures from Global Payments Europe, ČSOB acquiring, KB SmartPay, Česká spořitelna and Comgate to triangulate scheme-fee levels.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash usage and ATM economics are barely covered by scheme sources — schemes publish card/contactless penetration but say little about CZ cash withdrawal volumes, and ATM interchange appears only as a line item inside the interchange PDFs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat scheme sources as a card-side-only input for the cash-usage topic; extract ATM interchange lines from the Visa/Mastercard CZ PDFs and otherwise route the cash topic to CNB/ČSOB-ATM-operator cells.

coverage_gaps.description: The mandatory-disclosure layer (interchange, rulebooks) is English-only while the statistical layer (press releases) is strongest in Czech — neither language alone covers the cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dual-language collection schedule: cs crawls for newsrooms and media relays, en crawls for visa.co.uk / mastercard.com disclosure paths and rulebook diffs.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller international networks in CZ (JCB, Discover/PULSE post-Diners, and any emerging account-to-account scheme positioning against cards) are undocumented in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Dedicated follow-up pass targeting JCB corporate/European sites, Discover Global Network partner directories, and CZ acquirer brand-acceptance lists as an indirect census of which networks are live on CZ terminals.

coverage_gaps.description: Cash usage and ATM estate operators (independent ATM deployers, cash-in-transit, Euronet-style networks in CZ) were not covered in this cell's pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated cs pass on 'bankomaty síť provozovatel', 'Euronet ČR bankomaty', 'hotovostní oběh ČNB' to find ATM-network operators and cash-cycle statistics.

coverage_gaps.description: Company financial filings (Sbírka listin / justice.cz) for processors and acquirers were identified as a method but not enumerated as concrete sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add justice.cz Sbírka listin entries for Global Payments Europe s.r.o., Cataps s.r.o. and Bankovní identita a.s. as structured indirect sources with annual cadence.

coverage_gaps.description: CERTIS/instant-payments technical scheme documentation (ISO 20022 message specs, scheme rulebook annexes) was not individually catalogued beyond the rules landing page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl the CERTIS 'pravidla' section and its document gallery to catalogue rulebook versions and technical annexes for change tracking.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language CZ-specific sources are thin: most rail and standards documentation exists only in Czech; the EPC/ECB sources are the main en-language anchors.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat cs as the primary collection language for this cell and budget translation; use en sources only for cross-country comparability.

coverage_gaps.description: Card transaction values/volumes (as opposed to card counts) are not disclosed per-bank; only issuance counts and network sizes appear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with the ČNB payment-statistics cell for volume data and use bank IR only for actor-level shares and network footprint.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller but payment-relevant CZ banks outside the named eight (Česká spořitelna's Erste ecosystem partners, Trinity Bank, Creditas, Max banka, Partners Banka, plus Revolut/N26 branch presence) were not covered in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the ČNB mandatory-disclosure link registry as a seed to sweep the full list of licensed CZ banks and foreign branches.

coverage_gaps.description: Most actor-level metrics are locked in narrative PDF/XHTML annual reports rather than machine-readable series; ESEF XHTML covers only tagged financials, not card/ATM counts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-bank PDF extraction template keyed on Czech terms (počet aktivních platebních karet, bankomaty, platbomaty, vkladomaty, pobočky, aktivní uživatelé mobilního bankovnictví) and validate against the press releases.

coverage_gaps.description: Unlisted banks (Air Bank, Fio, Raiffeisenbank CZ, UniCredit CZ) report operational metrics only annually with a 4-month lag, while listed KB/MONETA and parents Erste/KBC report quarterly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Anchor the time series on the quarterly reporters and interpolate/annotate the annual-only actors; monitor their press rooms for interim datapoints.
